text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Once the commotion at the New Year's award ceremony had settled down, and on a day I finally noticed the cherry blossoms starting to peek open—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to further build up stamina,
I went out on the outer course with Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At her request, upon entering the Senior class,
we ramped up the training intensity even further than before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Moving forward, with our primary targets being GⅠs where the Senior Class elites gather, sharpening her skills is vital, but...
choice_data_list: Shall we wrap things up for now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
No.
We shall proceed according to plan.
choice_data_list: Then it really is over, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Why?
choice_data_list: You're so perfect, you can't see yourself objectively.
You're so perfect, you can't see yourself objectively.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...
Taking a longer break than scheduled is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow is a rest day...
This isn't where I should compromise."
choice_data_list: Got it, let's pick this up again in the evening

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I am most glad
that you understand.
choice_data_list: Want to head back to the academy for now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "Are you coming along as well?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Since she rarely invited me anywhere, I followed Mejiro Ramonu... and we arrived at a park brimming with blooming flowers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
It's overflowing with color...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if love
is like a flower.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether love is a flower... Quite an abstract question.
Love is love, and a flower is a flower, surely. But I understand
you seek its essence, so I shall rack my brain—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Beautiful flowers comfort the heart. For the same reason, gentle love also comforts the heart. In that sense, one could say love is like a flower, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I didn't have the courage to say it with certainty. Love isn't necessarily made entirely of warm things. If that's the case, what does that make the flower—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I'm in trouble.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Love is love,
and flowers are flowers."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What else could there be?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I never asked for
the 'correct answer,' you know."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It was merely a passing question.
A playful whim, surely.
choice_data_list: ...So you're not a flower either, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh,
and why is that?
choice_data_list: Because it's love in its purest form.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
No,
I wonder if I am a flower...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Flowers wither.
Someday, my legs will stop too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Those were words completely unexpected coming from her mouth. She had always spoken of running forward as if it were the most natural thing in the world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
And yet...
Love never fades.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"None.
Because my love is an act of will."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I have resolved to love.
If the spark begins to fade, I shall burn myself to keep it alight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
That is why I will resist—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —As Mejiro Ramonu continued her stroll, words spilled from her bit by bit. Like sparks scattering from an inner flame.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Once cherry blossoms fall,
they're smeared with brown mud and trampled underfoot."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It is perhaps best to fall while at the height of one's beauty,
entrusting the future to the next bud.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall scatter and fall
when I am at my most beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yet, that "time" is...
found in this very journey itself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
“—Until the day love runs dry,
I shall remain the most beautiful.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm dragged through the mud day after day.
I won't let myself just drift along with the flow of time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every Umamusume's body ages eventually.
Hence, a peak always exists... Yet, she intends
to remain in her prime for her entire lifetime.
choice_data_list: (If a girl like that really exists... it'd be a miracle.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And she was the Umamusume
who had made those miracles happen up until now—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I wonder if a flower like this... looks unsightly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —"Isn't it beautiful?" her expression seemed to say without words. Mejiro Ramonu possesses both the confidence and the true sensation of loving.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: If only I could be like you...
If only I could do it like you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The words slipped out—Mejiro Ramonu loves racing
with her entire body, her very being...
That's something I could never do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Merely running is easy enough. But loving
the "race" itself—that is completely impossible for me.
choice_data_list: Even if I wanted to dedicate everything I truly am—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I won't laugh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I want to know everything, I want to have everything,
I want to dedicate everything...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Because I love you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "I, too... cannot love the way you do."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —A circle. Love is a complete, perfect circle...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It begins "here,"
and ends "here."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...All you need to do
is connect your circle without any gaps."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I haven't fully grasped the entire meaning. But as a fellow lover of the races... I understood that she was encouraging me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—It will be evening soon.
Let us do what must be done.
